preconditions.description: The number of nodes in each tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of edges in each tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The arrays A and B contain exactly 2*e values representing edges.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u, v < n for u, v in zip(A, A[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each edge in A is represented by a pair of nodes u and v where 0 <= u, v < n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u, v < n for u, v in zip(B, B[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each edge in B is represented by a pair of nodes u and v where 0 <= u, v < n.

postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if the trees are mirror images of each other, and 0 otherwise.
